description: List the event's ticket holders (up to 200). Use it for who is registered or checked in; use list_speakers for speakers. Returns attendees[] with contactId, name, email, ticketType, ticket status, and checkedInAt, plus a truncated flag.

eventId.description: Event id, as returned by list_events.

org.description: Organization slug from list_my_orgs; only needed if you belong to several.

name: list_attendees

checkedInAt.description: Check-in time in epoch milliseconds, or null.

truncated.description: True when more rows exist than were returned (a cap was reached).
